args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The round_money docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding,
but the implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. Update the quantize call
to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN so halves round to the nearest even cent,
fixing the nightly test failures in tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` implemented `round_money` using `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite the docstring claiming ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: changed the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and FIN-212.

## Verification
- CI run ci-0001 on `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` → `2.66`, `2.675` → `2.68`).

Reviewer: @alex
